sources.title: SARDE: A Framework for Continuous and Self-Adaptive Resource Demand Estimation
sources.coverage: Primary preprint sections 5.2-5.4 on cross-validation, tuning, real/proxy errors and learned selection. Ordinary two-block selector implemented; full pipeline untested.
sources.relevance: Window/step tuning, estimator selection and internal cross-validation proxies.

sources.title: Estimating Computational Requirements in Multi-Threaded Applications
sources.coverage: Primary author PDF sections 3-6; BL equation (1), RPS equation (3), CPU-related response and shared-CPU assumptions. Single-worker elapsed special case only; no full published implementation.
sources.relevance: Alternatives using response/resource-queue observations; detailed quota applicability unaudited.

sources.title: Moving Horizon Estimation of Service Demands in Queuing Networks
sources.coverage: Primary author PDF sections II-III equations (1),(3)-(8); open one-queue observed-flow/exposure adaptation; explicit seconds correction and quadrature sensitivity. No full network QP executed.
sources.relevance: Passive transient demand inference from queue traces; known topology/routing, exponential services and fluid approximation.

sources.title: DEC: A Technique for Estimating Resource Demands of Software Services
sources.coverage: Kalbasi's 2010 primary thesis: title, chapters 3–4 selected passages, benchmark acquisition and chapters 5–6 confidence limitations inspected
sources.relevance: Benchmark mixtures, replication-based demand confidence and validation; narrow regression intervals can accompany poor predictions. Not full verification of the 2012 journal revision.

sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Resource Allocation for Multi-Path Programs with In-Kernel Predictions
sources.coverage: Primary paper: abstract, problem/approach and conformal-calibration/shift passages in sections 4–6 inspected
sources.relevance: Offline state/allocation profiles and held-out error calibration; uncertainty-aware deadline constraints; marginal rather than conditional coverage, shift assumptions.

sources.title: A Gentle Introduction to Conformal Prediction and Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification
sources.coverage: Primary author tutorial section 1.1 finite-sample rank/marginal coverage; section 5.5 conditional selected-risk control and i.i.d. assumptions. Count feasibility only; no guard reproduction or guarantee.

technical_reference.title: CFS Bandwidth Control — Linux Kernel documentation
technical_reference.coverage: Overview, hierarchy and quota caveats inspected
technical_reference.usage: Quota is an upper CPU-time budget, with replenishment, throttling and per-CPU slices; do not equate it to guaranteed continuous supply.

scope: Targeted applicability assessment, not exhaustive firstness search
